subject: Where were you?
body:
You were asleep, and you were somewhere else. Did it feel real? I wrote down everything I know about the place. @archive:integrated_boogaloo:witchery_spirit_world

If something in there starts following you, don't run. Turn around and deal with it. Don't run from your worst fears, face them head on.

That doesn't apply to me though. Just you.

Your old friend,
Dr. T
